items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: It was Kratka's band and, and he hired, uh, uh, Bunk and, and everybody else.

ctx.x: But this caravan, those dances were...was Bunk supposed to be there for all of those or was that your band or what was it? I don't remember. Well, uh...it wasn't there.
It was Kratka's band and, and he hired, uh, uh, Bunk and, and everybody else. Bunk was just, just had that time open and took the job. Yeah.
Bunk was supposed to be there regularly then. Yeah. It wasn't just as a start of special guest once a month or something.
